scope: Read-only static analysis and installed vanilla map comparison supporting the building editor correction.

evidence.finding: Province center is the integer-truncated average of all scanline pixel coordinates.
Process each adjacency pair from its lower-ID side. Gather unique source-side pixels having a cardinal neighbor in the other province.
Flood-fill border pixels with eight-neighbor connectivity; retain the largest component.
Average the component using fixed-point contributions; convert to integer by rounding. Store the resulting shared adjacency anchor at +0x20.
Select an actual adjacent sea (excluding land/lake) by its closest pixel to the supplied point.
Ordinary coastal rotation uses atan2(land_center_z - anchor_z, land_center_x - anchor_x) - pi/2.

Floating harbor: normalize anchor minus land center, multiply by define distance, add anchor. Accept only inside selected sea; otherwise use sea center. Rotation is atan2(position_z - anchor_z, position_x - anchor_x) - pi/2.
NGraphics.DEFAULT_NUDGE_FLOATING_HARBOR_DIST = 7.0, documented as distance from coast in pixels for nudger.

editor_differences: If the sea-center fallback is outside its own concave sea, the editor snaps to that sea's nearest actual pixel to preserve valid output.
Horizontal seam directions use the shortest wrapped difference. Exact engine behavior for all seam-center cases is not established.
The engine's equal-distance sea ordering and equal-size coast-component ordering may differ from our deterministic ordering.
Ordinary port positions still use eligible shoreline candidates; matching the original random sequence is outside scope.

validation.sample: First 100 floating_harbor records in the installed vanilla buildings.txt
validation.interpretation: Partial agreement only. Existing shipped placements are not a fresh live Nudge run. Differences may involve historical/manual records or unrecovered engine details; their cause is not established.
validation.live_nudge_comparison: Not performed. Do not claim exact vanilla parity.
